description: Fetches a full Bible chapter from a specific version, formatted in Markdown with numbered verses. Use this when the user needs chapter-level context instead of an isolated verse.

book.description: Bible book name, slug, or abbreviation. Accepts supported localized names such as "John", "João", "Salmos", or "1 Sm".

chapter.description: Chapter number within the selected book. Must be 1 or greater.

version.description: Bible version slug to read from, such as "onbv", "kjv", "bsb", or "rvr1909". Must be enabled by the connection URL filters.

name: get_chapter

copyright.description: Attribution the version license requires (e.g. CC BY-SA). Present only for versions that need it; show it with the text.

reader_url.description: Link to read the passage on midvash.com.

book.description: Book name in the language of the version.
